## Evidencia tangible

El evidence pack oficial ya no es una lista de todas las olas. Es el conjunto
minimo que permite defender que Paper 4 existe como laboratorio reproducible.

| finding_id | finding | status | quarto_page |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F01 | Paper 4 is a reproducible sequential-decision living lab, not a policy-selection or deployment protocol. | official | index.qmd |
| F02 | The active external CRPTO IJDS paper is a retrospective identification audit with no selected learner or policy. | external_contract | 19ca-v38-final-synthesis.qmd |
| F03 | The v31 implementation materialized 512 internally generated paths and 494592 policy-month-path rows. | descriptive_artifact | 19t-multi-period-solver.qmd |
| F04 | The preselected CVaR configuration records a conditional tail-loss/wealth tradeoff in one internal simulator. | diagnostic_only | 19i-regret-auditability-frontier.qmd |
| F05 | The v35 six-month and source-family views are post-selection slices, not strict holdouts. | diagnostic_only | 19n-online-mdcp-fairness.qmd |
| F06 | PyEPO is retained as a descriptive teacher-cost benchmark on sampled top-k menus. | diagnostic_only | 19cc-v39-pyepo-real-suite.qmd |
| F07 | DLA/ADP has a formal state/transition framing and failure analysis, but not exact Bellman optimality. | rollout_only | 19t-multi-period-solver.qmd |
| F08 | Paper 4 retains the former IFRS9/SICR lane only as a negative readiness-and-estimand audit; it does not identify PD, ECL, SICR or staging. | diagnostic_negative_audit | 19b-current-assets-and-gaps.qmd |
| F09 | CATE policy value remains blocked; the high-rate-within-grade result is an observational, noncausal sensitivity. | diagnostic_only | 19b-current-assets-and-gaps.qmd |
| F10 | Fairness remains proxy/source governance only because protected attributes or approved proxy protocol are absent. | proxy_only | 19n-online-mdcp-fairness.qmd |
| F11 | Powell/SDAM is useful as a governance and framing contract, not as an automatic optimizer. | official | 19f-sequential-decision-framework.qmd |
| F12 | Literature-driven Lab 4 pass closes lanes 1-9 as append, park, diagnostic-negative-audit or context-only evidence. | official_with_boundaries | 19ca-v38-final-synthesis.qmd |
| F13 | Archived Paper 2 artifacts are retained only as non-citable provenance and a negative estimand audit. | diagnostic_negative_audit | 19ca-v38-final-synthesis.qmd |
| F14 | A legacy-root calibrated model outperformed an origin-time FICO proxy in an archived OOT diagnostic. | append | 19cb-v38-appendix-registers.qmd |

## Regla de uso

Cuando una nueva ola produzca resultados, primero se agrega al notebook. Solo si
se vuelve estable, artifact-backed y claim-safe se promueve a una pagina oficial.
